$comment: DRAFT for the owner, 2026-11-07: the PoolPlayer dancer of the billiards room, who stops Macron and dances with a cue stick. Age, look and pronouns are proposals. They/them until the owner states otherwise. The cue is in the sheet's words for now: the frames stage still needs a prop kind for it, since the pipeline refuses 'cue'.
description: Billiards room opponent, the PoolPlayer dancer: an elegant adult of about sixty, a player of long standing who uses a cue stick as a dancing prop.
traits: elegant upright adult woman of about sixty, a calm knowing smile, silver hair in a neat bob
demeanor: patient, exact and amused, as if already three shots ahead

garments.text: crisp ivory blouse with the sleeves rolled to the elbow
fitted billiard-green waistcoat with brass buttons
high-waisted charcoal trousers with a sharp crease

drawing.fits: hair, both shoes and both hands
drawing.look: slim upright adult build, warm brown skin, an oval face with fine smile lines and a calm knowing smile, neat silver chin-length bob, small gold stud earrings, crisp ivory blouse with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, fitted billiard-green waistcoat with brass buttons, high-waisted charcoal trousers with a sharp crease, polished oxblood brogues and thick dark ink outline
drawing.extra: Both eyes are open. She is a grown woman of about sixty, fully clothed. In her right hand, at the picture's left, she holds a long slim wooden billiard cue upright, its butt resting on the floor beside her shoe and its pale tip above her head.

front.description: standing square and upright facing the viewer, feet a little apart, her left arm relaxed and held a little away from her body with the open hand visible, her right hand holding the cue upright beside her

back.description: seen from directly behind, her back to the viewer, standing upright with feet a little apart, the plain back of her waistcoat and the back of her silver hair, her right hand holding the cue upright beside her
back.look: slim upright adult build, warm brown skin, neat silver chin-length bob seen from behind, ivory blouse with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, billiard-green waistcoat with a plain satin back and a small buckle, high-waisted charcoal trousers, polished oxblood brogues and thick dark ink outline
